paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.4, with a change of -3.03% compared to the prior close and 2.4% over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of August 14, 2026.

There are 2 new news items in the last 24 hours, both from Bloomberg, regarding Fermi Inc. receiving a US subpoena tied to Project Matador, a data center campus it is developing in west Texas. One of the news items provides a summary stating that the subpoena is for certain documents related to the project.

There are 25 total filings in the feed, including 1 Form 4 filing and 12 proxy solicitation filings. Recent filings include a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, and other 8-K forms disclosing financial results and new officer appointments.
